rootCause.whyOrphan: Task was created as a re-merge attempt (status=failed, no pr_number). Multiple downstream 'Merge: Three consecutive Vercel builds failing' tasks were all cancelled (at least 8 rows in tasks table, all cancelled 2026-06-13), indicating the orchestrator kept attempting to create merge tasks but never succeeded in opening a PR. The branch has the fix committed but no PR was ever opened.
rootCause.fixDescription: QueryBuilder in lib/db.ts implements PromiseLike<any> but only defined then(). TypeScript correctly rejects .catch() call sites (TS2339) because PromiseLike does not require catch(). Fix adds catch() and finally() delegate methods and changes then() return type from PromiseLike to Promise, making QueryBuilder a full thenable.
